senses.en: To move through space (especially to or through a place). (May be used of tangible things such as people or cars, or intangible things such as moods or information.)

examples.en: Why don’t you go with us?
This train goes through Cincinnati on its way to Chicago.

senses.en: To move or travel through time (either literally—in a fictional or hypothetical situation in which time travel is possible—or in one's mind or knowledge of the historical record). (See also go back.)

examples.en: Yesterday was the second-wettest day on record; you have to go all the way back to 1896 to find a day when more rain fell.
Fans want to see the Twelfth Doctor go to the 51st century to visit River in the library.

senses.en: To navigate (to a file or folder on a computer, a site on the internet, a memory, etc.).

examples.en: For the best definitions, go to wiktionary.org

senses.en: To move (a particular distance, or in a particular fashion).

examples.en: We've only gone twenty miles today.
This car can go circles around that one.

senses.en: To move or travel in order to do something, or to do something while moving.

examples.en: We went swimming.
Let's go shopping.

senses.en: To leave; to move away.

examples.en: Please don't go!
I really must be going.

senses.en: To end or disappear. (Compare go away.)

examples.en: After three days, my headache finally went.

senses.en: To work (through or over), especially mentally.

examples.en: I've gone over this a hundred times.
Let's not go into that right now.

senses.en: Of a ball, to be capable of being potted, not having its path to the pocket obstructed by other balls.

examples.en: He'd like to pot the pink, but I don't think it will go. The green's in the way.

senses.en: The act of going.
A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).

examples.en: You’ve been on that pinball machine long enough—now let your brother have a go.
It’s your go.

senses.en: An attempt, a try.

examples.en: I’ll give it a go.

senses.en: A period of activity.

examples.en: ate it all in one go

senses.en: A time; an experience.
An approval or permission to do something, or that which has been approved.

examples.en: We will begin as soon as the boss says it's a go.

senses.en: Working correctly and ready to commence operation; approved and able to be put into action.
A strategic board game, originally from China and today also popular in Japan and Korea, in which two players (black and white) attempt to control the largest area of the board with their counters.

examples.en: I wonder how long it's going to take.
examples.vi: Tôi tự hỏi nó sẽ biết bao lâu.

examples.en: Tomorrow, I'm going to study at the library.
examples.vi: Ngày mai tôi sẽ học ở thư viện.

examples.en: What time do you usually go to bed?
examples.vi: Bạn hay ngủ lúc mấy giờ?

senses.en: The spectral composition of visible light.

examples.en: Humans and birds can perceive color.

senses.en: A particular set of visible spectral compositions, perceived or named as a class.

examples.en: Most languages have names for the colors black, white, red, and green.
What color are your bf's eyes?

senses.en: Hue as opposed to achromatic colors (black, white and grays).

examples.en: The accident victim's face was white, drained of all color.

senses.en: These hues as used in color television or films, color photographs, etc (as opposed to the shades of grey used in black-and-white television).

examples.en: This film is broadcast in color.
Most people dream in color, but some dream in black and white.

senses.en: Any of the standard dark tinctures used in a coat of arms, including azure, gules, sable, and vert.
A paint.

examples.en: The artist took out her colors and began work on a landscape.

senses.en: Human skin tone, especially as an indicator of race or ethnicity.

examples.en: Color has been a sensitive issue in many societies.

senses.en: Conveying color, as opposed to shades of gray.

examples.en: Color television and movies were considered a great improvement over black and white.

senses.en: To give something color.

examples.en: We could color the walls red.

senses.en: To cause (a pipe, especially a meerschaum) to take on a brown or black color, by smoking.
To apply colors to the areas within the boundaries of a line drawing using colored markers or crayons.

examples.en: My kindergartener loves to color.

senses.en: To become red through increased blood flow.

examples.en: Her face colored as she realized her mistake.

senses.en: To affect without completely changing.

examples.en: That interpretation certainly colors my perception of the book.

senses.en: To attribute a quality to; to portray (as).

examples.en: Color me confused.
They tried to colour the industrial unrest as a merely local matter.

vi.senseHint: particular set of the visible spectrum

examples.en: What is the real color of the sky?
examples.vi: Màu sắc thật sự của bầu trời là gì?

examples.en: Here you can see beautiful colour combinations.
examples.vi: Bạn có thể thấy ở đây một số cách kết hợp màu sắc đẹp.

examples.en: The color of the sky is blue.
examples.vi: Màu của bầu trời là màu xanh da trời.

senses.en: A programmable electronic device that performs mathematical calculations and logical operations, especially one that can process, store and retrieve large amounts of data very quickly; now especially, a small one for personal or home use employed for manipulating text or graphics, accessing the Internet, or playing games or media.

examples.en: I spend around 6 hours a day at the computer.
As well as saving the photos on my computer, I have them backed up on a USB drive.

words.viShort: máy tính; máy vi tính; máy điện toán

examples.en: If I had money, I'd buy a computer.
examples.vi: Nếu tôi có tiền, tôi sẽ mua máy vi tính.

examples.en: Macintosh is a type of computer operating system.
examples.vi: Macintosh là một loại hệ điều hành.

examples.en: Windows is a type of computer operating system.
examples.vi: Windows là một loại hệ điều hành.

senses.en: An institution where one can place and borrow money and take care of financial affairs.
A branch office of such an institution.
An underwriter or controller of a card game.
A fund from deposits or contributions, to be used in transacting business; a joint stock or capital.
The sum of money etc. which the dealer or banker has as a fund from which to draw stakes and pay losses.
Money; profit.
To deal with a bank or financial institution, or for an institution to provide financial services to a client.

examples.en: He banked with Barclays.

senses.en: To put into a bank (financial institution).

examples.en: I’m going to bank the money.

senses.en: To store in a bank (storage).
To conceal in the rectum for use in prison.

examples.en: Johnny banked some coke for me.

senses.en: To provide banking services to.

examples.en: They proposed an ambitious plan to bank people in remote rural communities.
For quotations using this term, see Citations:bank.

senses.en: An edge of river, lake, or other watercourse.
To roll or incline laterally in order to turn.

examples.en: My sister works in a bank as a secretary.
examples.vi: Chị của tôi làm thư ký ở ngân hàng.

examples.en: The library has a valuable bank of old documents.
examples.vi: Thư viện có một kho lưu trữ giá trị những tài liệu cũ.

examples.en: She deposits 10,000 yen in the bank every month.
examples.vi: Mỗi tháng cô ta gửi 10.000 yên vào ngân hàng.

senses.en: Possessing beauty, impressing the eye; attractive.

examples.en: Anyone who has ever met her thought she was absolutely beautiful.
There's a beautiful lake by the town.

senses.en: Used emphatically or ironically, after the noun it qualifies.

examples.en: the house beautiful

senses.en: That one likes very much.

examples.en: He was a beautiful person; he would drop everything to help you.
You've done a beautiful thing today.

senses.en: Affording pleasure to any of the senses, especially that of hearing; delightful.

examples.en: Beethoven's most beautiful sonata
It's beautiful outside, let's go for a walk.

senses.en: Impressing with charm in an intellectual or moral way, through inherent suitability or elegance.

examples.en: The skater performed a beautiful axel.

senses.en: Someone who is beautiful. Can be used as a term of address.

examples.en: The man was faithful to his wife, ignoring the many blonde beautifuls who surrounded him wherever he went.
Yesterday I listened to a very beautiful song.
examples.vi: Hôm qua tui nghe một bản nhạc rất đẹp.

examples.en: She looked so beautiful in her wedding dress.
examples.vi: Cô ấy đã trông rất xinh đẹp trong bộ váy cưới của mình.

examples.en: Paris is the most beautiful city in the world.
examples.vi: Paris là một thành phố đẹp nhất thế giới.

senses.en: The act of appointing a person to hold an office or to have a position of trust.

examples.en: His appointment as treasurer was deemed suitable.

senses.en: The state of being appointed to a service or office; an office to which one is appointed.

examples.en: the appointment of treasurer

senses.en: A stipulation; an agreement; the act of fixing by mutual agreement.
An arrangement between people to meet; an engagement.

examples.en: They made an appointment to meet at six.
I’m leaving work early because I have a doctor’s appointment.

senses.en: A decree; a direction; an established order or constitution.

examples.en: to submit to the divine appointments

senses.en: The exercise of the power of designating (under a power of appointment) a person to enjoy an estate or other specific property; also, the instrument by which the designation is made.

examples.en: I canceled an appointment with her.
examples.vi: Tôi đã huỷ cuộc hẹn với cô ấy.

examples.en: I have an appointment at three.
examples.vi: Tôi có một cuộc hẹn lúc ba giờ.

examples.en: I make it a rule never to be late for appointments.
examples.vi: Tôi tự đặt ra quy định không bao giờ được đến muộn buổi hẹn.

senses.en: The second day of the week in many religious traditions, and the first day of the week in systems using the ISO 8601 norm. It follows Sunday and precedes Tuesday.
On Monday.

examples.en: We've worked out the schedule for Easter week: we'll be shopping Monday.
The shop is open from Monday to Saturday.
examples.vi: Cửa hàng đó mở cửa từ thứ Hai đến thứ Bảy.

examples.en: I'll be off duty at noon on Monday.
examples.vi: Tôi sẽ nghỉ làm vào trưa thứ Hai.

examples.en: I'll come pick to it up next Monday.
examples.vi: Tôi sẽ đến lấy nó vào thứ Hai tới.

senses.en: The fruit of the tree Malus domestica, chiefly with a green, red, or yellow skin, cultivated in temperate climates for cidermaking, cooking, and eating.

Often with a qualifying word: any fruit or vegetable, or any other thing (such as a cone or gall) produced by a plant, especially if from a tree and similar to the fruit of Malus domestica (noun sense 1.1).
Something which resembles the fruit of Malus domestica (noun sense 1.1) in shape (such as a ball, breast, or globe) or colour.
The round, fleshy part of a cheek between the eye and the corner of the mouth when a person is smiling.
The surface of revolution of a circular arc of an angle greater than 180° rotated about the straight line passing through the arc's two endpoints.
In full apple bowl: a round bowl of a tobacco pipe; also, a tobacco pipe with such a bowl.
To make (something) appear like an apple (noun sense 1.1).
To become like an apple.
